Name: PE_E___ApparentPower
Description: The total power (“total load”) of a piece of equipment or circuit. It combines both the real power (useful) and reactive power (non-useful) power to represent the total power flowing through the circuit. Measured in Volt-Amperes (VA).

Name: PE_E___Current
Description: The flow of charged particles (electrons) moving through an electrical conductor or space. Measured in Amps (A).

Name: PE_E___EquipmentConnection

Name: PE_E___LoadClassification
Description: Categorizes electrical loads into types, enabling detailed panel schedules, accurate demand factor application, and energy analysis.

Name: PE_E___LRA

Name: PE_E___MOCP

Name: PE_E___NEMAEnclosureRating
Description: NEMA enclosure rating of equipment

Name: PE_E___NumberOfPoles
Description: The number of poles which refers to the number of independent electrical paths that are in a switching device. (Number of hot connections on a device).

Name: PE_E___Phase
Description: Device is single or three phase

Name: PE_E___Voltage
Description: The “pressure” from an electrical circuit’s power source that pushes charged electrons (current) through a conducting loop (circuit), enabling them to do work such as illuminating a light. Measured in Volts (V).

Name: PE_E___VoltageLtoL
Description: The voltage difference between any two "lines" or "phases" (across two hot conductors). Measured in Volts (V).

Name: PE_E___VoltageLtoN
Description: The voltage difference between a phase conductor (“line” or “hot wire”) and the neutral point in a power system. Measured in Volts (V).

Name: PE_E_LoadCalc_LoadCategory
Description: This parameter denotes the load category for each device on the NEC load calculation tables.

Name: PE_E_LoadCalc_PercentProtected
Description: The percentage of the device's load that is protected by a backup energy source.

Name: PE_E_LoadCalc_Status
Description: The status (Confirmed, Placeholder, or Future) for each device on the NEC load calculation tables.
